The aligned view (fnasm 0x190:0x210 --diff) shows both sides emit `lfs f0,2360(r31)` at +0x1d0, and the whole 2356/2360/2364 triple agrees word for word. regnorm's own UNPAIRED-T @0x0238 / UNPAIRED-O @0x0230 lines give the cause: an lfs/stfs pair transposed one instruction earlier slips the positional alignment by one, so target instruction i was compared against our instruction i+1. The reloc half is the RS lane's ghost-extern/duplicate-lbl class (work_claim.reloc-symbol-sweep.20260831.v1) and is HANDED OFF, not fixed here.
